agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and ample force headroom (force ~10 vs limit 67.6) but sensor_noise ~0.016. Noisy angle/rate measurements cause state-feedback controller to apply incorrect forces that pump energy (E ~1.09 to ~25.26, external work ~24.17) instead of stabilizing, so pole angle diverges from -0.05 to 0.93 rad by step 46 exceeding 0.8 limit. Removing noise alone restores stability.
